description: 博登杀：弃马引象，弃后引兵，双象交叉将死
explanation_en: White first sacrifices a knight to deflect the bishop, then sacrifices the queen to draw a pawn away and open the diagonal for Boden's mate.

intro.popup: 💡 博登杀：精彩的多步组合！先弃马引离黑象，再弃后引离黑兵，最终形成博登杀。
intro.popup_en: 💡 Boden's mate: A brilliant combination in several stages. First sacrifice the knight to deflect Black's bishop, then sacrifice the queen to draw away a pawn and set up the mate.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：精彩的弃马引离黑象，弃后引离黑兵，形成博登杀。每步弃子都是为最终的双象交叉服务。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: The knight sacrifice deflects the black bishop, and the queen sacrifice draws away a pawn. Each sacrifice prepares the final bishop crossfire of Boden's mate.

moves.popup: 白马弃马Nxa7+！将军，引诱黑象来吃，清除a7格障碍。
moves.popup_en: Nxa7+! White sacrifices the knight with check, tempting Black's bishop to capture and clearing the obstruction on a7.

moves.popup: 黑象Bxa7吃马，离开原位，b8-a7对角线被占据。
moves.popup_en: Bxa7. The black bishop captures the knight and leaves its original square, occupying the b8-a7 diagonal.

moves.popup: 白后弃后Qxc6+！将军，引诱黑兵至c6，打开a6-c8对角线。
moves.popup_en: Qxc6+! White sacrifices the queen with check, drawing a black pawn to c6 and opening the a6-c8 diagonal.

moves.popup: 黑兵bxc6被迫吃后，b7格清空，对角线完全打开。
moves.popup_en: bxc6. The pawn is forced to capture the queen, vacating b7 and fully clearing the diagonal.

moves.popup: 白象Ba6#，博登杀！两步弃子铺垫，双象交叉将死，精彩！
moves.popup_en: Ba6# is Boden's mate! The two sacrifices have prepared a stunning crossfire checkmate with the bishops.
